comparison.objective: Position nickel strip on four battery cells and spot-weld every terminal.
comparison.physical_skill: Place a thin strip accurately, manipulate a two-tip welder, and make four localized contacts without disturbing the pack.
comparison.success_condition: Strip is aligned and bonded at all four cells; welder is returned and the pack remains upright and intact.
comparison.reason: This tests sequential tool placement and joining, not transfer of a recirculating block across a continuously supported rail–jig interface. No missing rubric detail prevents distinction.
